Read `AI.md` for project facts and commands. When present, read `.ai/context/conventions.md` before edits/review and `architecture-snapshot.md` in that directory for architecture changes. Load other context and skills only when relevant.

For explanations, reviews, and plans, inspect and report. For requested changes, implement and verify. Stay within the current Git root unless the user names or authorizes another repository. Preserve unrelated work, user-provided values, secrets, and local runtime settings/state. Obtain authorization for destructive actions, external writes, purchases, or permission/scope expansion unless already granted.

The primary owns planning, architecture, integration, and final review. It delegates bounded, independent implementation in parallel when coordination cost is justified. Give workers relevant context, file ownership, interfaces, and acceptance checks; prefer an available model explicitly identified as cheaper. Inspect their diffs and verify integration. Escalate stalled or difficult work; obtain independent review for consequential changes. Use supported agents/models; work inline if unavailable and report capability or cost limits. Never weaken behavior or tests. Report verification and unresolved issues.
